import datetime,json,os,signal,statistics,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from tensorboard.backend.event_processing.event_accumulator import EventAccumulator
ROOT=Path('/home/young/liufengrong/robot_lab')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'))
import run_evaluation_batch as B
from evidence_provenance import read_reference,write_bytes,encode,digest
from summarize_evaluation_batch import validate_batch
RUN=ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-BeyondMimic-Flat-LW-leg-v0/2026-10-08_21-48-24'
PLAN_REF={'path': '/home/young/liufengrong/robot_lab/learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-BeyondMimic-Flat-LW-leg-v0/2026-10-08_21-48-24/evidence/training/checkpoint-comparison-plan-20261009-002.json', 'sha256': '87765a58e9eba7bcb0791508380232443a90769906f025aaa86e9593538068dd'}
PLAN=read_reference(PLAN_REF);PRE=read_reference(PLAN['preflight'])
TRAIN=PRE['training_baseline'];GUARDS=PRE['resource_guards']
for path,expected in PRE['protected_files_sha256'].items():
    assert digest(Path(path).read_bytes())==expected,path
EA=EventAccumulator(TRAIN['run_directory'],size_guidance={'scalars':0})
SUPERVISION=[];RECEIPTS=[];ABORT=False

def now():return datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
def training():
    p=Path('/proc')/str(TRAIN['pid'])
    alive=p.exists() and p.joinpath('stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]==TRAIN['process_start_ticks']
    EA.Reload();rr=EA.Scalars('Perf/total_fps')
    return {'observed_at':now(),'pid':TRAIN['pid'],'alive':alive,'step':rr[-1].step,'wall_time':rr[-1].wall_time,'median_fps_last64':statistics.median(r.value for r in rr[-64:])}
def gpu():
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','-i','0','--query-gpu=memory.used,memory.free,utilization.gpu','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],text=True)
    used,free,util=[int(x.strip()) for x in raw.strip().split(',')]
    return {'used_MiB':used,'free_MiB':free,'utilization_pct':util}
def stop_owned(process):
    if process.poll() is None:
        os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
        try:process.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait()
def execute(argv,console,timeout):
    global ABORT
    before=training();g=gpu();attempt=argv[argv.index('--evaluation_id')+1];candidate=argv[argv.index('--candidate_id')+1]
    record={'candidate':candidate,'attempt':attempt,'started_at':now(),'training_before':before,'gpu_before':g,'samples':[]}
    print('CASE_BEGIN '+json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    with console.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps({'argv':argv},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');stream.flush()
        if not before['alive'] or g['free_MiB']<GUARDS['minimum_free_before_launch_MiB']:
            record.update(guard_reason='prelaunch resource guard',ended_at=now(),exit_code=-1)
            SUPERVISION.append(record);ABORT=True
            stream.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
            return -1,'SupervisorAbort'
        process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=ROOT,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        record['owned_evaluator_pid']=process.pid
        started=time.monotonic();slow_since=None;last_step=before['step'];last_progress=started;last_check=started
        guard=None
        try:
            while process.poll() is None:
                try:process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
                elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
                if elapsed>=timeout:guard='evaluation timeout';break
                if process.poll() is not None:break
                if time.monotonic()-last_check<15:continue
                last_check=time.monotonic();t=training();g=gpu();ratio=t['median_fps_last64']/before['median_fps_last64']
                sample={'elapsed_seconds':round(elapsed,2),'training':t,'gpu':g,'fps_ratio':ratio,'fps_ratio_to_idle_baseline':t['median_fps_last64']/GUARDS['throughput_observation_baseline_fps']}
                record['samples'].append(sample)
                print('CASE_PROGRESS '+json.dumps({'candidate':candidate,'attempt':attempt,**sample},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
                if t['step']>last_step:last_step=t['step'];last_progress=time.monotonic()
                if not t['alive']:guard='training process exited';break
                if g['free_MiB']<GUARDS['stop_evaluation_if_free_below_MiB']:guard='GPU free memory below reserve';break
                if time.monotonic()-last_progress>GUARDS['stop_if_training_step_stale_seconds']:guard='training step stopped progressing';break
                # Explicit approval accepts throughput loss; retain progress and memory guards.
            if guard:
                stop_owned(process);ABORT=True
            code=process.returncode
        except BaseException:
            stop_owned(process);ABORT=True;raise
    record.update(ended_at=now(),exit_code=code,guard_reason=guard,training_after=training(),gpu_after=gpu())
    if code!=0 and not guard:
        ABORT=True;guard='evaluation process failed';record['guard_reason']=guard
    SUPERVISION.append(record)
    write_bytes(console.parent/'supervision.json',encode(record))
    result=Path(argv[argv.index('--result_path')+1])
    if code==0 and result.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(result.read_text());record['metrics']={k:obj['metrics'].get(k) for k in ('successful_motion_episodes','failed_episodes','censored_episodes','body_position_rmse_m')};record['telemetry_status']=obj['telemetry_status']
    print('CASE_END '+json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    return code,'SupervisorAbort' if ABORT else None

for contract in PLAN['contracts']:
    if ABORT:break
    receipt=B.run_batch(contract,execute=execute)
    validate_batch(Path(receipt['batch']['path']),expected_sha256=receipt['batch']['sha256'])
    RECEIPTS.append(receipt)
    print('BATCH_END '+json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
changes=[p for p,h in PRE['protected_files_sha256'].items() if digest(Path(p).read_bytes())!=h]
impact={'version':1,'plan':PLAN_REF,'preflight':PLAN['preflight'],'training_final':training(),'gpu_final':gpu(),'supervision':SUPERVISION,'batch_receipts':RECEIPTS,'aborted':ABORT,'protected_file_changes':changes,'all_completed':len(RECEIPTS)==4 and all(r['all_completed'] for r in RECEIPTS)}
ref=write_bytes(RUN/'evidence/training/checkpoint-comparison-impact-20261009-002.json',encode(impact))
print('MATRIX_END '+json.dumps({'impact':ref,'all_completed':impact['all_completed'],'cases_executed':len(SUPERVISION),'protected_file_changes':changes},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
assert not changes,changes
